newsitem.title: USA: PCA to buy American Studios for $2.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: PCA to buy American Studios for $2.50/shr.

text.p: PCA International Inc said Wednesday it had agreed to acquire American Studios Inc for $2.50 cash per share, or about $66.4 million, plus the assumption of debt and capital lease obligations.
The transaction has been unamiously approved by the boards of both companies, PCA said.
It did not say when it expected to close the transaction.
The company said it had received a $100 million credit line from NationsBank and NationsBanc Capital Markets.
American Studios has about 21.4 million common shares outstanding, PCA said.
